title: Google\Cloud\Dataproc\V1\AutoscalingConfig
name: AutoscalingConfig
description: Autoscaling Policy config associated with the cluster.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.policy_uri
params.description: Optional. The autoscaling policy used by the cluster. Only resource names including projectid and location (region) are valid. Examples: https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/[project_id]/locations/[dataproc_region]/autoscalingPolicies/[policy_id] projects/[project_id]/locations/[dataproc_region]/autoscalingPolicies/[policy_id] Note that the policy must be in the same project and Dataproc region.

methods.name: getPolicyUri
methods.description: Optional. The autoscaling policy used by the cluster.

methods.name: setPolicyUri
methods.description: Optional. The autoscaling policy used by the cluster.
